boards.title: Zero Dollars: 10 Hangs That Cost Nothing
boards.description: Ten no-extra-cost activities for CSUB students, plus a recurring free public museum evening in Bakersfield.

cards.title: Train Together in a Four-Person Group
cards.subtitle: Student Recreation Center · CSUB students and All Access members
cards.notes: Register at the SRC front desk or RecStore, then meet your small group in Yosemite Studio; sessions have four-person limits.
cards.short_summary: A coached, small-group workout included with eligible SRC access.
cards.evidence_claim: CSUB states that Small Group Training is open to students and All Access members, has no cost, and is included in membership.
cards.source_title: Small Group Training | California State University, Bakersfield
cards.access_notes: CSUB students and All Access members only; registration is required, and spaces are limited.

cards.title: Drop Into a Group Fitness Class
cards.subtitle: Student Recreation Center studios · Valid SRC members
cards.notes: Check the current semester schedule, arrive five minutes early, and wear movable clothing and sneakers; advance signup is unnecessary.
cards.short_summary: Instructor-led fitness with no separate class charge for SRC members.
cards.evidence_claim: CSUB’s Group Fit FAQ says classes are free to valid SRC members and do not require advance registration.
cards.source_title: Group Fit FAQ | California State University, Bakersfield
cards.access_notes: Valid SRC membership is required; consult the current schedule and arrive before capacity is reached.

cards.title: Take a Runner Ride Around Campus
cards.subtitle: CSUB Campus Recreation · Fee-paying SRC students
cards.notes: Bring your student ID, request a day-use bike through Campus Recreation, and choose a comfortable campus loop while following road rules.
cards.short_summary: A no-extra-cost day-use bicycle outing for eligible CSUB students.
cards.evidence_claim: CSUB’s catalog says Campus Recreation members can check out a free bicycle for day use and that fee-paying SRC students have program access.
cards.source_title: Student Affairs and Strategic Enrollment Management | California State University, Bakersfield
cards.access_notes: Available to eligible Campus Recreation members; bring a valid CSUB ID and confirm day-use availability.

cards.title: Walk Laps Above the Gym
cards.subtitle: Student Recreation Center · Fee-paying CSUB students
cards.notes: Scan in with your CSUB ID, set an easy group pace, and use the three-lane suspended track for a weather-proof walk between classes.
cards.short_summary: An indoor walking hang on the SRC’s one-tenth-mile track.
cards.evidence_claim: CSUB identifies a three-lane, one-tenth-mile suspended track and says facility access is covered through student fees.
cards.access_notes: No additional admission for fee-paying students; a valid CSUB ID is required for SRC entry.

cards.title: Try the SRC’s Climbing Wall
cards.subtitle: Student Recreation Center · Fee-paying CSUB students
cards.notes: Bring your CSUB ID, ask staff about current climbing procedures, and start on an appropriate route at the 34-foot freestanding wall.
cards.short_summary: A staffed indoor climbing session using a centerpiece SRC facility.
cards.evidence_claim: CSUB describes The Rock as a 34-foot freestanding climbing wall, and student SRC access includes the rock wall without a separate facility charge.
cards.access_notes: For fee-paying students with valid CSUB ID; follow staff instructions and posted climbing requirements.

cards.title: Organize a Casual Basketball Run
cards.subtitle: SRC Three-Court Gymnasium · Fee-paying CSUB students
cards.notes: Scan in with your student ID, check the day’s court availability, and gather a group for open recreation rather than a reserved event.
cards.short_summary: Pick-up basketball on the SRC’s indoor recreation courts.
cards.evidence_claim: CSUB says its three-court gymnasium offers open recreation basketball and that access to recreation facilities is covered through student fees.
cards.access_notes: No additional admission for fee-paying students; court availability varies around classes, intramurals, and club practices.

cards.title: Rally on an Indoor Court
cards.subtitle: SRC Three-Court Gymnasium · Fee-paying CSUB students
cards.notes: Check open-gym availability at the front desk, borrow eligible sports equipment if available, and rotate games so everyone gets court time.
cards.short_summary: A casual pickleball meetup inside the SRC gymnasium.
cards.evidence_claim: CSUB lists pickleball among open recreation options in its gymnasium and states that facility access is covered through student fees.
cards.access_notes: Fee-paying students enter with valid CSUB ID; verify court and equipment availability before starting.

cards.title: Recharge in the Wellness Suite
cards.subtitle: Student Recreation Center, second floor · Fee-paying CSUB students
cards.notes: Reserve a nap pod or massage chair through the RecStore, or use the reflection and craft areas for a quiet reset with friends.
cards.short_summary: A low-key campus break centered on rest, reflection, or crafts.
cards.evidence_claim: CSUB says the Wellness Suite has reservable nap pods and massage chairs plus student seating, and that recreation facilities and services are covered through student fees.
cards.access_notes: SRC access is included for fee-paying students; nap pods and massage chairs require reservations and may be unavailable.

cards.title: Cheer at a Roadrunner Game
cards.subtitle: CSUB Athletics venues · Current students
cards.notes: Check the official athletics calendar, secure a student ticket when required, and bring the identification specified for event entry.
cards.short_summary: Student admission to a scheduled CSUB home sporting event.
cards.evidence_claim: CSUB’s Student Union FAQ states that sporting-event admission is free for students, although a physical ticket may be required.
cards.source_title: Student Union Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs) | California State University, Bakersfield
cards.access_notes: Current students only; consult the athletics calendar and obtain a physical ticket when the event requires one.

cards.entity_name: Bakersfield Museum of Art First Friday
cards.title: Browse Art on First Friday
cards.subtitle: Bakersfield Museum of Art · Free public program
cards.notes: Visit on the first Friday of the month, explore the current galleries together, and follow posted rules for bags, food, and photography.
cards.short_summary: A recurring free-admission evening at Bakersfield’s downtown art museum.
cards.evidence_claim: The Bakersfield Museum of Art states that First Friday offers complimentary admission and extended hours from 11 a.m. to 8 p.m.
cards.source_title: Hours & Admission — Bakersfield Museum of Art
cards.access_notes: Free to the public only on First Friday; current posted hours are 11:00 a.m.–8:00 p.m.
